records.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Make one 1536x1024 photorealistic architectural interior photograph by rendering ONLY the supplied model image. The model is a strict geometry AND material-location map. Preserve exact camera, framing, foreground occlusion, walls, beams, windows, doors, furniture shapes, cabinet divisions, equipment and object counts. Match the material class and color of EACH modeled surface. Gray flat floors are GRAY TILE; only floors already showing a wood pattern are gray-brown HERRINGBONE WOOD with reduced red/orange. Plain gray walls and pillars remain smooth gray paint, NOT stone. Opaque black/gray cabinet fronts stay opaque black/gray. Wood-grained surfaces stay desaturated gray-brown timber. Glass cabinet fronts stay transparent; a double-sided island glass cabinet has glass on BOTH sides and no opaque backing. Preserve exact shelf contents: empty shelves stay EMPTY. Never add figures, appliances or objects to empty cabinets. Lighting is restrained daylight plus the EXISTING fixtures, realistic soft shadows and material reflections. Do not introduce stone except where an actual textured stone feature panel is shown directly behind an existing TV or inside the fixed SOUTH display cabinet. Do not add lamps, plumbing, windows, furniture, decorative objects, people or extra openings. Real fine textures and photographed depth, not a flat CAD render, illustration or clay model. No text or watermark. All dimensions remain visually identical to the supplied image.
Room-specific constraints: Service balcony. Preserve exact air-conditioner outdoor condensers, fan counts, washer/dryer units where visible, service sink and safety parapet/rail. Large white rectangles with black circles are mechanical equipment, not TVs, speakers or washing machines unless actually the depicted washer tower. No new equipment, wooden deck, timber floor, plants or closed glazing. Basin and mirror are separate, mirror is not a new door. Practical gray floor with subdued outdoor daylight.
